name: Acid Splash
description: is a cantrip (Conjuration). It deals ⁠Acid damage to enemies in a small area.

name: Blade Ward
description: is a cantrip (Abjuration). It allows spellcasters to become more resilient against physical damage.

name: Bone Chill
description: is a cantrip (Necromancy). It deals ⁠Necrotic damage and prevents the target from regaining Hit Points.

name: Booming Blade
description: is a cantrip (Evocation). It allows the caster to strike with their melee weapon, dealing further damage if the target moves afterwards.

name: Bursting Sinew
description: is a cantrip (Necromancy). It allows the caster to detonate a corpse into a small AoE of damage.

name: Dancing Lights
description: is a cantrip (Evocation). It creates magical orbs of light that brighten an area.

name: Animal Friendship
description: is a level 1 enchantment spell. It charms a beast, convincing it that the caster means no harm.

name: Armour of Agathys
description: is a level 1 abjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to create a spectral armour of frost that covers the caster and their equipment. This armour provides additional Hit Points to the caster and damages hostile targets while the added hit points are present.

name: Arms of Hadar
description: is a level 1 conjuration spell. It allows the caster to summon dark tendrils and deal ⁠Necrotic damage to creatures in an area centered on the caster, preventing them from taking Reactions.

name: Bane
description: Bane is a level 1 enchantment spell. It allows the caster to temporarily curse enemies, making their attacks miss more often and weakening their Saving Throws.

name: Bless
description: is a level 1 enchantment spell. It allows spellcasters to temporarily bolster themselves and their allies’ attacks and saving throws.

name: Burning Hands
description: is a level 1 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to shoot a flaming cone from their fingertips and deal ⁠Fire damage to enemies.

name: Charm Person
description: is a level 1 enchantment spell. It allows spellcasters to temporarily charm a humanoid creature, granting Advantage on Charisma Checks.

name: Chromatic Orb
description: is a level 1 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to fire a ball of energy and deal the chosen damage type to enemies.

name: Colour Spray
description: is a level 1 illusion spell. It allows spellcasters to temporarily blind enemies with flashing coloured light, making their attacks miss more often and shortening their attack range.

name: Command
description: is a level 1 enchantment spell. It allows spellcasters to order their target to flee, move closer, freeze, drop to the ground, or drop their weapon.

name: Compelled Duel
description: is a level 1 enchantment spell. It allows spellcasters to compel an enemy to ignore other targets and attack only the spellcaster.

name: Create or Destroy Water
description: is a level 1 transmutation spell. It allows spellcasters to conjure or destroy an area of water (or water-like surfaces).

name: Cure Wounds
description: is a level 1 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to heal allies with divine magic through touch.

name: Disguise Self
description: is a level 1 illusion spell. It allows spellcasters to temporarily change their appearance. While active, gain access to the action Dispel Disguise to end the effect.

name: Divine Favour
description: is a level 1 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to empower their Weapons to deal extra Radiant damage.

name: Enhance Leap
description: is a level 1 transmutation spell. It allows spellcasters to increase a creature's Jumping distance.

name: Ensnaring Strike
description: is a level 1 conjuration spell. This spell allows spellcasters to use weapon attacks to ensnare enemies with thorny vines and deal ⁠Piercing damage to them each turn.

name: Entangle
description: is a level 1 conjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to conjure magical vines and turn an area within range into difficult terrain. Creatures are possibly Entangled and move at half speed while standing in this area.

name: Expeditious Retreat
description: is a level 1 transmutation spell. It allows spellcasters to move more swiftly.

name: Faerie Fire
description: is a level 1 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to conjure a brilliant light. Any creature caught in the radius temporarily sheds faint light and prevents Invisibility.

name: False Life
description: is a level 1 necromancy spell. It allows spellcasters to gain Temporary Hit Points.

name: Feather Fall
description: is a level 1 transmutation spell. It allows spellcasters to make themselves and their allies light as a feather, preventing damage when falling from extreme heights.

name: Find Familiar
description: is a level 1 conjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to conjure a fey familiar that can aid them in combat and world exploration.

name: Fog Cloud
description: is a level 1 conjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to summon a sphere of Fog on an area in range and heavily obscure the area. Creatures within the area are Blinded.

name: Goodberry
description: is a level 1 transmutation spell. It allows spellcasters to create magical berries which have healing properties when eaten.

name: Grease
description: is a level 1 conjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to conjure flammable Grease on the ground within range and turn it into Difficult Terrain.

name: Guiding Bolt
description: is a level 1 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to hit enemies with a bolt that deals ⁠Radiant damage and grants advantage to the next attack roll made against them.

name: Hail of Thorns
description: is a level 1 conjuration spell. It allows the caster to make a ranged attack which creates a ⁠Piercing damage explosion in addition to dealing normal weapon damage.

name: Healing Word
description: is a level 1 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to heal allies that they can see and are within range.

name: Hellish Rebuke
description: is a level 1 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to surround a creature in hellfire that deals ⁠Fire damage as a Reaction when taking damage from them.

name: Heroism
description: is a level 1 enchantment spell. It allows spellcasters to instill courage in themselves or an ally; the affected creature cannot be frightened and gains temporary hit points.

name: Aid
description: is a level 2 abjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to heal and embolden their allies and themselves with resolve. Affected creatures have their maximum Hit Points increased for the duration of the spell.

name: Arcane Lock
description: is a level 2 abjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to magically lock a container.

name: Barkskin
description: is a level 2 transmutation spell. It allows spellcasters to fortify the defense of a willing creature and increase their Armour Class. While under the effect of this spell, the target's skin has a bark-like texture.

name: Blindness
description: is a level 2 necromancy spell. It allows spellcasters to magically Blind a targeted hostile creature.

name: Blur
description: is a level 2 illusion spell. It blurs the spellcaster's body, making them harder to hit.

name: Branding Smite
description: is a level 2 evocation spell. It causes a spellcaster's weapon to gleam with astral radiance, allowing them to mark targets with light, preventing them from turning Invisible.

name: Calm Emotions
description: is a level 2 enchantment spell. It allows spellcasters to magically subdue intense emotions in targeted creatures. The affected target becomes neutral to the creatures it was hostile toward. It also cannot be Charmed or Frightened during the duration of the spell.

name: Cloud of Daggers
description: is a level 2 conjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to conjure a barrage of daggers in an area which deals Slashing damage to any creature entering or starting its turn in the area.

name: Crown of Madness
description: is a level 2 enchantment spell. It allows spellcasters to temporarily charm a humanoid creature and induce madness in their mind. The affected creature then makes a melee attack against any creature aside from the caster within its reach.

name: Darkness
description: is a level 2 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to conjure a cloud of darkness in an area within range which obscures and inflicts Blindness to those within it.

name: Darkvision
description: Darkvision is a level 2 transmutation spell. It allows spellcasters to alter a creature's sight, granting them the ability to see in the dark.

name: Detect Thoughts
description: is a level 2 divination spell. It allows spellcasters to telepathically link to unprotected minds and hear the thoughts of targeted creatures while talking to them.

name: Enhance Ability
description: is a level 2 transmutation spell. It allows spellcasters to strengthen an aspect of a creature's physical or mental attributes.

name: Enlarge/Reduce
description: is a level 2 transmutation spell. It allows spellcasters to alter a creature's body size. The caster can choose to double or halve the size of the affected creature.

name: Enthrall
description: is a level 2 enchantment spell. It allows spellcasters to capture the attention of a creature, forcing it to focus on them.

name: Flame Blade
description: is a level 2 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to summon a fiery scimitar in their free hand that sheds bright light. Casters can make a melee weapon attack with the blade to deal Fire damage to enemies.

name: Flaming Sphere
description: is a level 2 conjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to conjure a Flaming Sphere which can attack and burn enemies.

name: Gust of Wind
description: is a level 2 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to conjure a squall to clear dangerous gasses or throw creatures back, potentially causing a dangerous fall.

name: Heat Metal
description: is a level 2 transmutation spell. It allows spellcasters to heat up a metal weapon or armour on the targeted creature, forcing them to let go or receive damage or suffer various penalties.

name: Hold Person
description: is a level 2 enchantment spell. It allows spellcasters to hold a target humanoid in place. The affected creature is unable to move or act and is more susceptible to attacks.

name: Invisibility
description: Invisibility is a level 2 illusion spell. It allows spellcasters to turn themselves and other creatures Invisible to the naked eye.

name: Knock
description: is a level 2 transmutation spell. It allows spellcasters to unlock non-magical locks.

name: Animate Dead
description: is a level 3 necromancy spell. It allows spellcasters to animate a corpse to create an undead servant.

name: Beacon of Hope
description: is a level 3 abjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to bolster their allies with hope and vitality.

name: Bestow Curse
description: is a level 3 necromancy spell. It allows spellcasters to curse a target with their touch.

name: Blinding Smite
description: is a level 3 evocation spell. It allows a Paladin to expend a Spell Slot to deal additional ⁠Radiant damage with a melee weapon attack and possibly blind their target.

name: Blink
description: is a level 3 transmutation spell. It allows the spellcaster to travel to the Ethereal Plane, unassailable and unseen until they return.

name: Call Lightning
description: is a level 3 conjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to call down lightning to hit all targets within the area of effect. The spellcaster can also call down lightning repeatedly on subsequent turns.

name: Conjure Barrage
description: is a level 3 conjuration spell. It allows rangers to use one of their weapons to strike everyone within a wide cone with a barrage of magical blades.

name: Counterspell
description: is a level 3 abjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to interrupt another caster's spellcasting, causing it to fail and have no effect.

name: Crusader's Mantle
description: is a level 3 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to imbue their allies' weapons with holy power, causing them to deal additional Radiant damage.

name: Daylight
description: is a level 3 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to dispel darkness by summoning a sphere of light or enchanting an item to shine like the sun.

name: Elemental Weapon
description: is a level 3 transmutation spell. It imbues a weapon with a chosen energy type, increasing its damage and accuracy.

name: Fear
description: is a level 3 illusion spell. It allows spellcasters to terrify targets by projecting phantasmal images, forcing enemies to flee.

name: Feign Death
description: is a level 3 necromancy spell. It allows spellcasters to put their allies into a magical, protective coma, feigning death.

name: Fireball
description: is a level 3 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to unleash a streak of fire from their hands which ignites into a large explosion at a chosen point within range.

name: Banishment
description: is a level 4 abjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to temporarily send a target to another plane of existence.

name: Blight
description: is a level 4 necromancy spell. It allows spellcasters to drain the moisture and vitality from a target creature using necromantic energy. It is especially effective versus plants.

name: Confusion
description: is a level 4 enchantment spell. It allows the caster to confuse a group of creatures, drastically reducing their effectiveness in combat.

name: Conjure Minor Elemental
description: is a level 4 conjuration spell. It conjures 2 Mud Mephits, 2 Ice Mephits, or an Azer to fight for you.

name: Conjure Woodland Being
description: is a level 4 conjuration spell. It summons a Dryad to fight alongside the caster.

name: Death Ward
description: is a level 4 abjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to prevent a target from dying.

name: Dimension Door
description: is a level 4 conjuration spell. It teleports the caster and an ally.

name: Dominate Beast
description: is a level 4 enchantment spell. It allows spellcasters to temporarily charm a Beast into fighting alongside the caster, rather than against them.

name: Evard's Black Tentacles
description: is a level 4 conjuration spell. It summons tentacles in an area that make it difficult to move and harm creatures.

name: Fire Shield
description: is a level 4 evocation spell. It shields the spellcaster with luminous energy.

name: Banishing Smite
description: is a level 5 abjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to imbue their weapon with power, dealing force damage and possibly Banishing the target.

name: Cloudkill
description: is a level 5 conjuration spell. It conjures a moveable cloud which damages and obscures everything it envelops.

name: Cone of Cold
description: is a level 5 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to blast icy air into a region in front of them, damaging affected creatures and turning existing Water surfaces into Ice Surfaces.

name: Conjure Elemental
description: is a level 5 conjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to summon a Fire, Earth, Water, or Air Elemental.

name: Contagion
description: is a level 5 necromancy spell. It allows spellcasters to infect their target with an affliction of their choosing, potentially resulting in the target contracting a disease.

name: Curriculum of Strategy: Artistry of War
page: Curriculum of Strategy: Artistry of War
description: is a level 5 evocation spell. It is a unique spell which fires a devastating barrage of homing projectiles that deal ⁠Force damage. Only wizards can learn this spell by transcribing it from a unique scroll.

name: Destructive Wave
description: is a level 5 evocation spell. It allows the caster to create a massive shockwave that damages enemies and can possibly knock them prone.

name: Dethrone
description: is a level 5 necromancy spell. It is a unique spell which deals a devastating amount of ⁠Necrotic damage to a single target. Only wizards can learn this spell by transcribing it from a unique scroll.

name: Dispel Evil And Good
description: is a level 5 abjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to protect themselves from Evil and Good creatures, and allows them to break Enchantments on allies.

name: Dominate Person
description: is a level 5 enchantment spell. It allows spellcasters to force a humanoid to temporarily fight as an ally.

name: Arcane Gate
description: is a level 6 conjuration spell. It creates two connected portals which allow creatures to freely teleport between them.

name: Blade Barrier
description: is a level 6 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to summon a wall of cutting blades.

name: Chain Lightning
description: is a level 6 evocation spell. It allows casters to create a bolt of lightning which strikes a target and chains to nearby enemies.

name: Circle of Death
description: is a level 6 necromancy spell. It devastates all creatures within a large radius with ⁠Necrotic energy.

name: Create Undead
description: is a level 6 necromancy spell. It allows spellcasters to animate a corpse, creating an undead servant.

name: Disintegrate
description: is a level 6 transmutation spell. It allows casters to deal devastating ⁠Force damage to a single target, possibly destroying it completely.

name: Eyebite
description: is a level 6 necromancy spell. It allows casters to choose amongst one of three debilitating conditions to impose on a single target.

name: Flesh to Stone
description: is a level 6 transmutation spell. It allows the caster to Atrophy a foe, Restraining them until they temporarily turn to stone.

name: Globe of Invulnerability
description: is a level 6 abjuration spell.

name: Harm
description: is a level 6 necromancy spell. It allows spellcasters to greatly enfeeble an enemy.

name: Heal
description: is a level 6 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to substantially heal a target by recovering Hit Points and removing Blindness and Diseases.

name: Heroes' Feast
description: is a level 6 conjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to summon a bountiful smorgasbord to bolster themselves and their allies and strengthen their resolve.

name: Sights of the Seelie: Summon Deva
page: Sights of the Seelie: Summon Deva

name: Bhaal's Power Word Kill Ritual
description: is a unique spell cast by Farslayer of Bhaal Ghislev which casts Power Word Kill on a target after completing a multi-turn ritual. Upon completion, the target of the ritual dies instantly if below 101 hit points.

name: Karsus' Compulsion
description: is a level 9 enchantment spell. It is granted by the Triune Netherstone and is usable only by Full-Illithids to control the Crown of Karsus.

name: Formsculpt: Tressym
description: Formsculpt Tressym is a level 9 transmutation spell. It transforms a creature into a Tressym.

name: Divine Revelry
description: is a level 9 enchantment spell. It allows Gale to create a firewine barrel and force several creatures to dance in place.

name: Elemental Retort
description: is a level 5 evocation spell. It is unique to Lorroakan, allowing him to retaliate with elemental damage siphoned from his myrmidons when attacked. Each of Lorroakan's myrmidons adds 3d8 damage to to this spell and an additional Reaction to cast it with. It cannot be learned by party members.

name: Finger of Death
description: is a level 7 necromancy spell. It is only available to Apostle of Myrkul after it consumes a Necromite and has the condition Reaper's Reward. It cannot be learned by party members.

name: Hellfire Orb
description: is a level 6 evocation spell. It allows spellcasters to unleash a streak of fire from their hands that ignites into a large explosion at a chosen point within range. It cannot be learned by party members.

name: Incinerate
description: is a level 6 evocation spell. It can be cast by Raphael for two Soul Charges, dealing 8d8⁠⁠Fire damage in an area. It cannot be learned by party members.

name: Keeper's Fee
description: is a level 5 spell. It is unique to Helsik in Tactician difficulty, and disarms a target. It cannot be learned by party members.

name: Lovely Assistant
description: is a level 5 necromancy spell. When Malus Thorm's assistants are dead, he uses this spell to reanimate them. It cannot be learned by party members.

name: Beckoning Darkness
description: is a level 4 necromancy spell. It curses a creature to take ⁠Necrotic damage if it enters or starts its turn in a Lightly or Heavily Obscured area.

name: Brand the Weak
description: is a level 1 transmutation spell. It imposes vulnerability on an enemy to ⁠Bludgeoning, ⁠Slashing, or ⁠Piercing damage.

name: Challenge to Duel
description: is a unique spell-like action which can be cast when wielding Duellist's Prerogative. It allows spellcasters to compel an enemy to only attack them.

name: Danse Macabre
description: is a level 5 necromancy spell. It summons 4 uncontrollable Ghouls to fight for the caster.

name: Draconic Elemental Weapon
description: is a level 3 transmutation spell. It imbues a weapon with a chosen energy type, increasing its damage and accuracy. This item spell is similar to the Paladin spell Elemental Weapon.

name: Elemental Age
description: is a level 3 transmutation spell. It enhances the caster's main hand weapon with a chosen element, increasing its damage and accuracy.

name: Ensnaring Strands
description: is a level 1 conjuration spell. It is an item spell similar to Ensnaring Strike which can be cast while wielding Cruel Sting.

name: Exhort the Risen
description: is a level 1 enchantment spell. It allows the caster to command the undead, similar to the spell Command.

name: Find Familiar: Cheeky Quasit
description: is a level 1 conjuration spell. It is a special version of Find Familiar: Quasit that summons the quasit named Shovel.

name: Flesh to Gold
description: is a level 6 transmutation spell. It restrains a target and turns it into gold after 3 turns.

name: Howl of the Dead
description: is a cantrip. It afflicts all nearby creatures with the Numbed condition and can be cast while wearing Reaper's Embrace.

name: Kereska's Favour
description: is a level 4 evocation spell. Granted by Markoheshkir, it allows its caster to imbue themselves with an element, thereby unlocking resistances and spells associated with it.

name: Khalid's Gift: Aid
description: is a level 3 abjuration spell. It allows the wearer of Khalid's Gift to cast a version of Aid to increase their hit points by 10.

name: Paralyzing Ray
description: is a level 3 necromancy spell. It paralyses its target.

name: Protection from Missiles
description: is a level 2 abjuration spell. It protects the caster against ranged weapon attacks for up to 10 turns.

name: Ray of Fear
description: is a level 3 necromancy spell. It is a unique spell which frightens its target and can be used by equipping the amulet The Spectator Eyes.

name: Ride the Winds
description: is a level 3 transmutation spell. It can be cast when wearing the Amulet of Windrider and transforms the wearer into a small cloud of mist. It is equivalent to Gaseous Form except it only affects the caster.

name: Selûne's Dream
description: is a cantrip (Evocation). It heals an ally, but may also put them to sleep. Selûne's Dream is in game only as a once per Long Rest action granted by the Amulet of Selûne's Chosen.

name: Shar's Aegis
description: is a level 1 abjuration spell. It allows spellcasters to surround themselves with Shar's protection and gain a bonus to their Armour Class, reduce incoming damage and apply ⁠Necrotic damage to all attackers.[See: Bugs]

name: Summon Quothe the Raven
description: is a level 3 conjuration spell. It summons the raven Quothe.

name: Wounding Ray
description: is a level 3 necromancy spell. It is a spell granted by The Spectator Eyes which allows the user to shoot a deadly necrotic beam.
